title: llms.txt: overview film
description: Your site, explained to AI agents. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 55 seconds: llms.txt for TYPO3 v14. An operating guide for agents; One file per language; No extra fields to fill. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: AI agents read your site without a map, and a hand-written llms.txt goes stale with the next new page.
Every TYPO3 site and language serves an llms.txt and an agents.md, built from the page tree.
agents.md lists the machine interfaces your site really has.
Each language gets its own file, with translated titles and URLs.
Page titles and descriptions become the links, so there is nothing extra to maintain.
llms.txt for TYPO3. Always up to date.
